title: Samiddhi’s Question About a Sentient Being
html:
• Saṁyutta Nikāya 35.66 Linked Discourses 35.66
  • 7. Migajālavagga 7. With Migajāla

Samiddhisattapañhāsutta Samiddhi’s Question About a Sentient Being

“‘Satto, satto’ti, bhante, vuccati. “Sir, they speak of this thing called a ‘sentient being’. Kittāvatā nu kho, bhante, satto vā assa sattapaññatti vā”ti …pe…. How do we define a sentient being or what is known as a sentient being?” …

Catutthaṁ.
